status: POST-HOC DEV RESEARCH — not confirmatory; C3 (repeats 17-20) reserved

arm_notes.WHOLE_E1_STRADDLE: historical Week 18 E1 (FREEZE_ROUND_2: GPR on log max depth + straddle, per-step ML-II); response = Week 7 OLD / phase1 NEW whole-record max (src.week18_tasks.depth_map)
arm_notes.ACTIVE_E1_STRADDLE: identical code; response = A_active_max_um (Week 19 audit; NaN for H-e7dbd8e5ce, whose query is still paid and whose label is kept)
arm_notes.G3_MARGIN: historical Week 18 REF (G3 'phase2' schedule = per-step ML-II for R1/R3, safeguarded Laplace FP_TOL 1e-9) + margin

R3_NEW.q20: unchanged Week 18 construction (R3_NEW: boundary_flags; R3_OLD: Week 8.5 distance rule; R1_POOLED: pooled-q20)

R3_OLD.q20: unchanged Week 18 construction (R3_NEW: boundary_flags; R3_OLD: Week 8.5 distance rule; R1_POOLED: pooled-q20)

R1_POOLED.q20: unchanged Week 18 construction (R3_NEW: boundary_flags; R3_OLD: Week 8.5 distance rule; R1_POOLED: pooled-q20)

seeds: task seed from src.week18_tasks ([1820,rep,fold] R3_NEW; [1822,rep,fold] R3_OLD; [1818,rep,fold] R1_POOLED); startup maximin rng = seed+[2]; engine rule rng = seed+[RULE_ID,11] (unused by straddle/margin)
startup: src.week18_engine.startup: 8 maximin points of the paid pool + maximin continuation until both classes are revealed; identical for all arms; every query costs 1

transformations.E1: StandardScaler on log(pool X); log response standardized on paid finite responses; ARD Matern-3/2 + white noise; learned threshold: midpoint if separable, else logistic C=1e6 on log response
transformations.G3: StandardScaler on raw pool X and pool log h; fixed-mean Laplace GPC (ARD Matern-3/2), ML-II one L-BFGS-B start

acquisition.straddle: argmax 1.96*sd - |mu - log u| over unpaid pool (src.week18_engine.choose)

fits: one learner fit after every paid query from the startup size to 80 (original methods); test predictions recorded at every fit
leakage_guard: the learner receives y and responses with every unpaid row masked (y=-1, response=NaN); held-out labels and q20 flags are evaluator-only

endpoints.primary: R3_NEW pooled-per-repeat BA AULC (trapezoid over 16..80 step 4 / width), ACTIVE_E1_STRADDLE - G3_MARGIN; per-repeat values and the Week 18 repeat bootstrap (4000, seed 0)
secondary: R3_OLD and R1_POOLED (grid 16..80 step 8) for all contrasts
specificity, sensitivity, short-K sensitivity (fixed ten NEW positives; NEW and POOLED-NEW rows), Brier, AUC at B40/B80 and as AULC
endpoints.query_savings: QTT (Week 18 qtt): first grid budget at which an arm's repeat-pooled BA reaches G3_MARGIN's repeat-1-4 mean BA at B40 and at B80 on the same task; unreached by B80 = 'not reached' (no extrapolation); means use B80 + one grid step for unreached (Week 18 qtt_reduction convention), always with the unreached count
endpoints.mechanism: learned thresholds per step from the ledgers; u >= 200 um episodes; paid composition before the first such step; late-negative timing as precedence only

hypotheses.T1-H0_fidelity: Arms A and C reproduce the historical Week 18 DEV caches (phase3/depth3 E1; phase2 G3|mlii|margin) on repeats 1-4 at every grid budget <= 80: max |p_new - p_cache| <= 1e-4 (cache rounding is 5 significant digits). Otherwise they are reported as re-implementations with the discrepancy.
hypotheses.T1-H1_primary: R3_NEW BA-AULC (grid 16..80 step 4), ACTIVE_E1_STRADDLE minus G3_MARGIN, is > 0. Supporting evidence: Week 19 shared-path pilot, B40 ACTIVE - G3 = +0.112 [-0.009, +0.212]; adaptive acquisition untested, so no magnitude is predicted.
hypotheses.T1-H2_ablation: R3_NEW BA-AULC, ACTIVE minus WHOLE, is > 0 (shared-path pilot B40: +0.098 [+0.013, +0.185]). No magnitude predicted.
hypotheses.T1-H3_old: R3_OLD: WHOLE minus G3 reproduces the historical DEV value (+0.0286 [+0.0117, +0.0518] on repeats 1-4 up to B80); ACTIVE minus WHOLE is small (|delta| < 0.01), because whole max and A separate OLD labels equally well (AUC 0.99996 both; 37/405 runs differ).
hypotheses.T1-H4_pooled: R1_POOLED: WHOLE minus G3 reproduces the historical DEV value (+0.0028 [-0.0003, +0.0062]); ACTIVE minus G3 >= WHOLE minus G3 (A separates POOLED labels better: AUC 0.9987 vs 0.9958). No magnitude predicted.
hypotheses.T1-H5_threshold: WHOLE E1 on R3_NEW reproduces the historical high thresholds (u >= 200 um in 6 of 20 folds of repeats 1-4: r1f5, r2f1, r3f1, r3f2, r4f1, r4f2). ACTIVE E1 never reaches u >= 200 um on R3_NEW (every NEW negative has A <= 131.2 um). Falsified by any ACTIVE R3_NEW step with u >= 200 um.
hypotheses.T1-H6_precedence: In every WHOLE R3_NEW run with a u >= 200 um step, the late negative H-f4fc937e86 was paid before the first such step. This is temporal precedence only; causal attribution would need an isolated refit and is not claimed.
hypotheses.T1-H7_secondary: No expectations are set for q20, short-K sensitivity, Brier or AUC; they are reported.

failure_rules: fit exception, non-finite prediction or non-finite acquisition score: the run stops there, status recorded, later budgets missing; no reseeding or repair
single-class usable response pairs for an E1 arm: run stops (the engine's 111 um fallback is never used); cannot arise in DEV 1-4 (checked: the A-unavailable run is in no startup set)
logistic slope <= 0 or root outside the paid range: recorded, not repaired (historical behaviour)
G3 Laplace fixed-point error > 1e-6: recorded as a Week 18 convergence violation, run continues (historical behaviour)
no forced queries, no favourable-repeat selection; all 180 runs are reported
